- **Screenshots in feedback:** attach up to 3 images to a bug report or an idea.
  - Windows: *Window snapshot* (one click), *Add image…*, or just Ctrl+V after Win+Shift+S.
  - Android: *Add screenshot* opens the system photo picker; PhoneDrop gets access only to the photos you pick.
  - The website form takes images too (pick, paste or drop).
  - Images are shrunk and re-encoded on your device, so metadata such as the photo location never leaves it.

Updating works in-app (Updates on the phone, ⋯ → Update on Windows).
